description: Main source file for the 'bugreportz' utility, which interacts with Android's dumpstate service to generate bug reports, supporting options for progress display, streaming output, and version info.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the bugreportz command-line tool.

methods.name: show_version
methods.description: Displays the version number of the bugreportz tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line arguments, starts the dumpstate service, connects via socket, sets socket timeout, and calls appropriate bugreportz functions based on options.
